answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation: each identity must answer randomized hardware challenges from a co-located device tied to one fixed grid location, an island of verified space no operator can duplicate remotely. A single operator claiming N identities must physically occupy N distinct sites, since a shared address triggers the orchard of overlapping challenge windows and fails. Successful attestations accumulate in a signed vault the agent presents for work. Faking costs a real lease and device per identity, scaling linearly with N.
